Commentary.Commentary: On a slow and docile surface, India's pacers were the ones who asked more questions of the batsmen with Yadav standing out. There was good reverse on offer for the quicks and they made it count. The spinners haven't got much purchase as the track hasn't quite deteriorated as everyone expected it to. With a big lead to boot, India will want to make quick runs before the inevitable declaration. One over before the lunch break. Stay tuned.

INDIA WILL BAT AGAIN. Quite expected once Bangladesh batted through the session. A good one for India as they managed to mop up the final 4 wickets for just 66 runs added to the overnight score. Rahim's century was the highlight of their innings while Shakib and Mehedi too supported well as the tourists battled hard in reply to India's marathon batting effort.

OUT! 250 TEST WICKETS FOR ASHWIN! He is the fastest ever to reach the landmark as well. Wasn't a wicket-taking delivery though as he speared this down the leg side, Rahim went for the sweep but got a fine bottom edge that was smartly taken by Saha. The appeal for a catch was given instantly and Rahim didn't want to review it either. The umpires check for the no ball and Ashwin is fine. So, that wraps up the innings. INDIA LEAD BY 299 RUNS.
Rahim has been given out caught behind. No review but they are checking for the no ball.
FOUR! Excellent hit! Looped up on middle, Rahim steps out to that one and slams it past the bowler. Hit it very straight and the ball went whistling down to the fence for a boundary.
Floated on middle and leg, stays back and blocks it well.
Flatter outside off, sits back and blocks it well.
Tossed up on middle, gets across and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Fired in outside off, Rabbi defends with the ball hitting him high on the bat.
Flatter on middle and leg, Rabbi defends with his bat in front of his pad.
Speared in around off, reaches out to that one and blocks.
Fuller around off, leans into it and pats it back to the bowler.
Drifting in from around off, Rahim steps out to play the big shot but gets a thick inside edge towards wide mid on. Single taken.
Fuller on middle, Rahim presses forward and blocks.
Very full on middle, defends it on to the track.
Tossed up gently outside off, Rabbi pushes hard at it and the ball hits him high on the bat. Gets it past silly point.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks it towards cover.
Floated outside off, the reverse sweep this time and gets a single towards third man.

FOUR! CHEEKY FROM RAHIM! Goes for the premeditated scoop to a fuller ball on the stumps. Gets it a bit uppish but also in the gap down to fine leg for a boundary. Rahane made an effort but couldn't stop the ball.
Full on middle, gets across and works it on the leg side.
FLoated outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Floated on middle and off, defends it solidly off the front foot.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rabbi defends it with a dead bat.
KAMRUL ISLAM RABBI is the last man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Flatter outside off, Taskin pushes hard at it and gets an outside edge that flies low to first slip where Rahane pouches it with ease. Taskin's brief defiance comes to an end. We are down to the last wicket now.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out and drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Flatter on middle, stays on the back foot and defends it on to the track.
Full and outside off, reaches out to that one and defends well.
Floated around off, defended nicely off the front foot.
Another slider around off, Taskin is rapped again on the pads. Faint inside edge this time and it saves him from the lbw.
Full and outside off, leans into it and defends well.
HUGE APPEAL! Taskin misses the slider to be rapped on the pads. Massive shout for lbw but turned down. Looked close but perhaps the impact saved him. Yes, replays showed the same.
Slightly short outside off, Rahim gets back and taps it towards point for a single.
Fuller outside off, Taskin eases it through the covers for a brace.
Darted in outside off, stays in the crease and defends well.

FOUR! GETS LUCKY! Drifting in from outside off, Taskin winds up for a wild hoick but gets a thick edge that flies sharply over Rahane at first slip who had no time to react at all. It sped away to the fence in no time.
Drifting in from around off, Taskin pats it gently back to the bowler.
Fired in on middle, nudged in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks with a straight bat.
Flighted nicely around off, reaches out and blocks it solidly. He has looked very assured in his stay so far.
Shorter in a length and pushed through quicker, Taskin camps back to defend.
Tossed up gently around off, Taskin presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Flatter on middle, gets across and jabs it towards short leg.
Drifting in on a length on off, leans into it and blocks it towards short leg.
Tossed up gently outside off, eased gently towards mid off. Rahim wanted the single but is rightly sent back.
Flatter on middle, Rahim hangs back and blocks solidly.
Fuller outside off, bunted towards cover for a single.

NOT OUT! Good use of technology by Bangladesh! Flatter outside off, Taskin looks to push at it as Saha collects it well despite the extra bounce. The appeal for a catch is given by the umpire. Taskin isn't sure but Rahim after a chat with his partner signals for the review. Fair delivery and replays show the sound was of bat hitting pad. Snicko confirms it as well. Reprieve for Taskin.
Taskin has been given out caught behind. He opts for the review. There was a definite sound.
Fired in around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Floated outside off, Taskin leans into it and defends solidly.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks it solidly to cover.
RAVINDRA JADEJA comes on to bowl.
SIX! TONKED! Clear intent from Rahim now to move on. Tossed up ball around off, he steps out to that one and lofts it cleanly over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Floated outside off, Rahim steps out to that one and launches the drive inside out through extra cover. Excellent stroke and it raced away to the fence.
Drifting in on middle and leg, brushes Taskin's pads before going down the leg side towards the deep. They take a leg bye. Ashwin is getting some grip.
Flighted on middle and off, pushed off the front foot. Goes off the outer half towards gully.
Floated on middle, skids through to ping the front pad. Slight appeal for lbw but missing leg.
Tossed up outside off, whipped away towards long on for a single.
First signs of spin today as RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes on to bowl.
Fuller around off, leans forward to block it off the inside half towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim stays back and cuts it to deep backward point for a single. He is farming the strike cleverly although Taskin isn't looking shaky at all.
Too straight on middle and leg, gets an inside edge to deep square leg for a single.
Good length around off, Taskin is compact in defence by getting right behind the line.
Good length angled in on off, Rahim closes the bat face too early and gets a leading edge uppishly down to third man. Single taken.
Speared way outside off, left alone by Rahim.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR comes back.
Shortish outside off, Rahim feasts on the width and cuts it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball around off, Rahim stays in the crease and blocks.
Good length around off, stays back and blocks it solidly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length around off, stays back and blocks it solidly.
5th Test ton for Rahim.

FOUR! There it is! Well played skipper! The innings has been a story of grit and determination, albeit with some luck especially of that debatable run out yesterday. However, still Rahim does deserve credit. Coming to the ball, he clips a fuller ball down to fine leg where Ishant makes a fumble to concede the boundary. Rahim wasn't sure about if he had reached the milestone and eventually understands it. A big smile on his face.
Good length down the leg side, Taskin looks to work it away but misses.
Good length outside off, Rahim taps it towards cover for a single.
Short of a length angled in around off, gets right behind the line and defends.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and works it towards mid on.
Good length around off, Rahim stays back and blocks it with a straight blade towards cover.
Fuller and around off, blocked solidly off the front foot towards the bowler.
Drinks..
Angling into the stumps, Taskin stays in his crease and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, Taskin tries going for a drive but is beaten by the away movement.
Length delivery into the stumps, Ahmed defends it from his crease.
Down the leg side, left alone by Ahmed.
Into the pads, Ahmed tries to clip it on the leg side but he misses and the ball hits the thigh pad.
Short into the body, Taskin ducks under it.

NOT OUT! Short delivery into the body, Rahim goes for a pull but the ball hits something on its way through to Saha. The players appeal but the umpire denies it. Kohli feels that it has come off the gloves as he straightaway goes for the review. Replays show the ball did not hit the gloves and came off the arm-guard. So the umpire will stay with his decision and that means India have no reviews left.
Kohli has reviewed a caught behind appeal off Mushfiqur Rahim.
On the pads, Rahim clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Rahim stays in his crease to defend it on the off side.
Short delivery down the leg side, Rahim does not go for it.
Again a short delivery, Rahim ducks under it.

SIX! LUCKY! Short delivery to start with. Rahim goes for a pull and he is not in control of it. The ball catches the top edge and goes over fine leg. He is lucky that the ball just went over the ropes for a maximum. That gets Rahim into his 90s.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Taskin blocks it from his crease.
Taskin Ahmed is the next man in.

OUT! SHORT BALL HAS DONE THE TRICK! Again a short delivery and Islam tries to sit under it. But like the last ball he still has his glove and bat hanging in the air. The ball catches the the gloves and goes straight in the hands of the keeper. Saha takes an easy catch behind the stumps. The players appeal but the batsman has already started walking. Only two wickets left for Bangladesh.
Again short, Islam sits under it but his bat was still in air. Luckily he does not get his bat in the way.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery into the pads, Taijul shuffles and plays a pull shot. He is nowhere in control of the shot but still manages to get a boundary through the leg gully region.
Yadav comes round the wicket and bowls it a bit short. The batsman pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Short delivery and Rahim sways away from the line of the delivery.
Angling into the pads, Islam tries to clip it but he misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Short delivery outside off, left alone.
Short delivery into the body, Taijul tries to fend it after taking his eyes away from the ball. He sits low and manages to defend it somehow as it kept low.
Short delivery into the body, Rahim pulls it through the mid-wicket region. A run taken.
Dug in short, Rahim does well to evade it.

Down the leg side, Rahim tries to pull it but the ball keeps low. He misses and the ball hits the pads and flies away to the keeper. The players appeal for a catch but the umpire denies. The replays show that the ball came off the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Inswinging delivery and that catches Islam by surprise. He tries to defend it but the ball goes through between his bat and the pad. Also luckily the ball did not hit the stumps and Taijul is surviving some scares.
On the pads, Rahim clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Rahim tries to cut it but the ball finds the inside edge and goes towards the keeper after a couple of bounces.
Length delivery outside off, Rahim pushes it back to Yadav. Yadav collects and fakes a throw at the stumps.
Angling into the pads, Rahim tries to clip it on the leg side but he misses. The ball gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire denies it and the ball was surely going down leg.

FOUR! Again short into the body, Taijul opens the face of the bat. The ball goes between the second slip fielder and gully fielder for a boundary. That ball went through the outer half of the bat. First boundary of the day.
Short into the body, Taijul tries to sway away but he had his bat hanging in the air. The ball hits the bat and goes towards the point region.
Angling into the stumps, Rahim clips it through the mid-wicket region. A single is taken.
Short and down the leg side, Rahim has left it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery outside off, the skipper drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Angling in from outside off, Rahim pushes it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Ishant Sharma is back in for a bowl.
Length delivery just outside off, Islam pushes it back to the bowler. Yadav dives to his right to stop it but the ball goes through. The non-striker accidently gets his foot in the way to stop it.
Falls short! Good length delivery and Islam stands tall and tries to defend it. But the ball catches the outside edge and falls short of the fielder at gully.
Length delivery and Islam again manages to drive it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery into the body, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
Short delivery just outside off, Taijul tries to slash at it but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, Taijul pushes it on the off side with the bottom half of the bat.
Short into the body, Rahim sits under that bumper.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, Islam clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Into the stumps, Taijul leans forward and drives on it but finds an inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, Taijul shoulders his arms on it.
Angling across after landing on middle, left alone.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Rahim drives it through the point region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, he is again beaten on a drive.
Again way down the leg side, Taijul has let that through and the keeper dives to his right to make a fine stop.
Down the leg side, Islam tries to flick it but fails to make contact.
Again a length delivery, Taijul tries to drive it but misses.
Dug in short! Islam does well to evade it.
Length delivery outside off, Islam tries to cut at it but misses.
On the pads, Islam clips it through square leg to keep strike.
Length delivery outside off, Islam gets an outside edge towards the fielder at gully.
Good length delivery outside off, Islam tries to nudge it on the off side but misses.
Short delivery into the body, Islam ducks under it.
Islam camps back and defends it.
Angling on the leg side, Rahim tries to flick it but the ball hits him high on the pads. The ball goes towards backward point after hitting. Leg bye is taken.
Islam lunges forward and defends it behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, Islam stays in his crease and goes for a drive but he misses.
On the stumps, Islam prods forward and defends it.
On a length outside off, Islam tries poking at it but is beaten.
Good length delivery outside off, Islam tries to defend it but he is beaten by the away movement.
On a fuller length outside off, Rahim drives it through point for a single.
Umesh Yadav will bowl from the other end.
Angling into the stumps, Islam defends it.

NOT OUT! Length delivery straying down pads, Islam tries to clip it on the leg side but he misses. The ball hits him high on the pads. A loud appeal but the umpire denies it. Kohli consults his players and goes upstairs for a review. Replays show that the ball pitched outside leg and so the on-field call will stay. The hosts have wasted a review.
India have taken a review for an LBW against Taijul Islam.
Taijul Islam will bat at number 8.

OUT! CASTLED! Fuller delivery which nips back in after pitching, Mehedi Hasan lunges forward and tries to defend it. But that ball has gone through his defence and rattled the timber. What-a-start for the Indians. Mehedi has to walk back without scoring a single run today.
On a good length and this time the ball nips back in after pitching, Hasan covers his stumps and lets that through.
Outswinging delivery from outside off, left alone.
Inswinging delivery into the stumps, Mehedi prods forward and defends it.
The players are out in the middle for the fourth day. Mushfiqur Rahim and Mehedi Hasan will continue with the bat for Bangladesh. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will begin the proceedings with the ball for India.

Pitch report - Sanjay Manjrekar says the pitch is not a result oriented one as we are used to seeing in India. Adds that there are roughs on the pitch but they are quite close to the stumps which the bowlers cannot exploit much. Opines that it is still a very good batting strip. Ends by saying the bowlers will need something special to get wickets.

Rahim found support in Shakib and Mehedi and will hope to continue in the same way with the latter. The main thing on their mind would be to avoid the follow-on which is still a massive 166 runs away. The hosts would want to stamp their authority in the game with some quick wickets and ask the away team some questions. Stay tuned to find out.

Hello and welcome to the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Hyderabad for the fourth day of the one-off Test between India and Bangladesh. The visitors with a couple of fantastic sessions have put up a brave fight and are inching closer to avoiding the follow-on. Their skipper has been the man to watch out for as he has played beautifully so far.
.... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ....

India's bowlers all tried hard on a pitch that didn't have many demons in it. There was the odd ball playing tricks but it was generally a good batting surface. The deficit is still a huge 365 for Bangladesh but at least they can pride themselves for the fight they have shown so far. Tomorrow should be another grueling day's play. Let's see how the pitch behaves. Join us at 0930 local, 0400 GMT to enjoy the fourth day's play. Till then, this is goodbye from us. Cheers!

A wicketless final session giving Bangladesh some respite to end what can be called an even day. It seemed like one-way traffic at lunch with the visitors struggling. Veterans Shakib and Rahim struck fifties to put the innings back on track. The former departed to a poor stroke but the skipper battled on, finding good company in the rookie Mehedi as Bangladesh ended the day on a high. Rahim did have a life as he seemed to be run out on 18 but the third umpire gave him the benefit of the doubt and the skipper cashed in.
What a ripper to end the day! Excellent bouncer from Ishant and equally well played by Rahim to sway away from the line of the bumper just in time. He survives to fight another day. STUMPS ON DAY 3.
There is a man at deep square leg now.
3000 Test runs for Rahim.

FOUR! TOP EDGE BUT SAFE! Dug in short on off, Rahim goes for the pull, almost out of compulsion due to the blow off the previous ball. Cannot control and gets a top edge but there isn't anyone in the deep at square leg as it goes to the fence.
The physio is out there once more to attend to Rahim. The visiting captain looks very ginger out there. Good news that he is finally ready to resume.

OUCH! That has hurt badly and Rahim is wincing in pain. Back of a length angled in around off, he tries to fend it on the back foot but is struck flush on the right glove. Immediately drops his bottom hand off the blade and signals the physio to come out to the ground.
FOUR! Fine batting! Good length outside off, Rahim stays back to that and delays the cut to find the gap at backward point as the ball races to the fence. Classy stroke that from the captain.
Short of a length around off, Rahim camps on the back foot and blocks it solidly on to the track.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks it firmly towards cover.
ISHANT SHARMA comes back on.
Flatter outside off, sits back and blocks solidly.
Maiden Test fifty for Mehedi. He becomes the youngest Bangladeshi player to score a Test half century against India. Well done son!

FOUR! Smart batting! Flatter outside off, stays back and essays a lovely late cut to the third man fence. Superb knock by the young man and he will hope to carry on. He has looked very confident and has rarely put a foot wrong.
Low full toss around off, steps out and slaps it down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Sharp turn! The off break rips in by a mile to rap Mehedi on the pad. The ball bobbles up for a while but no bat involved.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks solidly.
Flatter around leg stump, Rahim misses the flick and is struck on the pad.
Fired outside off, Rahim moves forward and blocks it well.
Fullish outside off, reaches out and defends it solidly.
On a length outside off, reaches out and blocks it well.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks  firmly.
Floated around off, gets well on the front foot and blocks solidly.
FOUR! Nicely struck! Flighted outside off, leans into it and thumps the drive through the extra cover region. Finds the gap and that races away to the fence.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks gently towards point.
Full on middle and leg, gets across and works it to the leg side.
Floated outside off, gets back to cut but gets a bottom edge that goes past slip. Rahane gives it a chase and stops them from taking a single.
Floated on middle, reaches out and drives it down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, reaches out and drives it towards mid on. Once again, Kohli's dive at short mid-wicket puts off the batsmen's aim for a single although he doesn't stop it.

This time it is Mehedi who is getting some treatment for his cramps. Not a bad way to eat up some time with stumps around the corner. He wouldn't want India to bowl more than the four minimum overs left in the day.
Drifting in from around off, nicely blocked by Hasan.
Quicker ball on off, Hasan defends it firmly to short leg where the fielder stops it and fires a direct hit at the keeper's end. Mehedi was well in.
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks it.
Fullish around off, gets a big stride forward and blocks firmly towards silly point.
Floated on leg stump, reaches out and jams it towards short leg.
Very full on off, steps out to that one and digs it out towards mid on.
Rahim is getting some treatment from the physio. Probably cramping up a bit, cannot fault him as he had kept wickets for a lengthy duration and has had to do a lot of work with the bat as well.
Slightly short outside off, Rahim gets back and cuts it towards backward point.
Fullish outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Flatter outside off, sits back and defends it with a straight bat.
Tossed up on middle, uses his feet and whips it past a diving Kohli at short mid-wicket. He cannot stop it but his effort creates enough doubt for the batsmen to abort the run.
A bit quicker this time around off, Rahim stays back and blocks well.
Flighted outside off, spins in to ping Rahim on the front pad.
Fired fuller outside off, Mehedi doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks solidly.
Unplayable stuff! Floats it up on off, drifting in and spins away sharply to beat the outside edge. Nothing much Mehedi or any batsman could have done to that.
Flatter outside off, Rahim lunges into it to block but the ball goes off the outer half towards short third man. A single taken.
Floated outside off, Rahim plays it very late as the ball goes off the outer half towards backward point.
Tossed up outside off, Rahim drives it crisply towards mid off.
Flatter and short outside off, Hasan looks to cut but cannot beat point.
Looped in around off, Mehedi lunges into it to block off the inside half of the blade.
Floated on a length around off, Mehedi rides the extra bounce to block solidly.
Drifting in from around off, stays back and blocks well.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Floated outside off, Mehedi uses his feet and makes room to launch the drive through extra cover to find the fence. Superb stroke to bring up 300 for Bangladesh. They trail by 385.
On a length on middle and leg, gets back and works it past short leg. Mehedi wanted the single but he is sent back.
Fuller outside off, Mehedi opens the face to steer it towards cover-point for a quick single. Direct hit at the keeper's end but Rahim was well in.
Tossed up gently on middle, very full and Mehedi digs it out.
Speared fuller around off, firmly driven towards cover.
Fuller on leg stump, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on leg stump, reaches out and defends solidly on to the track.
Slips it down the leg side, no shot offered to that one.
FOUR! NICE SHOT! The carrom ball but well outside off, Mehedi reaches out and drives it square of the wicket on the off side as the ball races to the fence. This lad continues to impress one and all.
Flighted outside off, Mehedi reaches out to that one and defends solidly.
Loopy around off, Mehedi defends it solidly from the crease.

FOUR! AGGRESSION FROM HASAN! Wasn't in control but still pulls it off. Floated on middle and leg, steps out to heave it over mid-wicket. Gets it off the inside half as the ball clears the fielder as it races to the fence.
Flatter and fuller on the stumps, Hasan keeps it out with a good block.
Fullish outside off, Hasan drives it firmly towards cover.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and dead bats it away.
Darted in around off, gets back and blocks well.
Fuller outside off, stays in the crease and blocks firmly.
Full and outside off, defended well from the crease.
50-run stand between Rahim and Mehedi. This has been a valuable stand for the tourists.
FOUR! UPPISH BUT IN THE GAP! Floated on middle and leg, Rahim goes for the sweep but gets a top edge of sorts. The ball goes between short fine leg and square leg as it trickles towards the fence.
Floated outside off, defended well from the crease.
Fuller around off, leans forward and drives it towards mid on.
Floated around off, Hasan misses the sweep as the ball bobbles past first slip. Came off his shoulder though.
Flatter outside off, sits back and defends it towards the off side.
Floated outside off, Mehedi defends it solidly from the crease.
Fired down the leg side, Mehedi misses the flick.
WHAT A RIPPER! The off break outside off, spins in sharply to cut Mehedi into half as it sneaks past the inside edge. Great start to the spell for the off spinner.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes on to bowl.
Fuller and on off, leans across and blocks it towards mid on.
Drifting in from outside off, MR gets well forward and smothers it.

On a length outside off, stays on the back foot and defends solidly.

Fuller on the stumps, Rahim leans into it and blocks solidly.
Back of a length around off, stays back and defends firmly towards mid on.
Shortish around off, stays back and blocks firmly to short cover.

FOUR! RISKY STUFF! Short and wide outside off, Mehedi slashes hard at it but gets it off the outside edge. Got it finer than he expected but it went over Rahul at first slip towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Fullish on middle, defends it solidly back to the bowler.
Full inswinger on middle, Mehedi shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

Flatter on off, Mehedi sits back and jams it on to the track.

Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
FOUR! Delicately done! Back of a length outside off, Rahim stays back and delays the cut. Gets it away fine to the third man fence for a boundary.
Drinks break....
Looped up outside off, comes well forward and blocks it towards cover.
Flatter and around off, Hasan reaches out and blocks firmly.
Drifting in around leg stump, gets across and nudges it towards short fine leg.
Full and around off, reaches out and jams it towards mid on.

Fullish on middle, leans across to that one and taps it to the leg side.
Short of a length outside off, Rahim tries to essay the cut but doesn't make contact.
Back of a length outside off, hangs on the back foot and defends well.
Fuller ball outside off, gets well forward and blocks it towards mid off.
Pitched up around off, leans across and blocks solidly down the track.

Fuller on off, tailing in a touch, dug out towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Spears it in on middle and leg, gets well forward and blocks.
Fuller on middle and off, Mehedi leans into it and defends firmly down the track.
Darted in around leg stump, worked towards the leg side for a single. Direct hit at the bowler's end but Rahim was in.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of Day 3 of the one-off Test between India and Bangladesh in Hyderabad. The hosts sit on top of the game after batting extremely well. With the exception of KL Rahul, every other Indian batsmen was amongst the runs. The massive total on the board means that the Bangladeshi players were under pressure heading into the fag end of the day.
.... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ....

It should be an exciting game of cricket tomorrow where the visitors will hope to spend some time out in the middle and build in the same way the hosts did. The Indian bowlers will want to come out roaring expecting the pitch to help the spinners so that they can impose the follow-on. Join us tomorrow at 0930 local (0400 GMT) for the Day 3 of this one-off Test match.

The hosts have managed to post a big score on the board, thanks to some sensational batting after losing their first wicket in their very first over. Vijay and Pujara steadied the ship but Pujara missed on his century. Kohli stepped up to Vijay's century by scoring yet another double hundred in this season. Rahane was also amongst the runs. Saha scored a ton as well and Jadeja chipped in with a fifty.

Just when it seemed like Bangladesh had survived the day, some terrific bowling by Umesh Yadav and an even better review by Virat Kohli broke the opening partnership. Sarkar was sent back but Tamim and Mominul managed to survive the day for the visitors.

India will be really happy with the session after they piled up 57 runs in just 13 overs which helped them post a big score of 687 runs on the board. Saha got his century and Jadeja also made it a point to reach his fifty in no time before the Indian skipper decided to call them back to the pavilion.
